title: Peri-peri chicken livers on toast
summary: Rich in iron, cheap and quick.
steps: Rinse the livers, pat them dry and cut away any white sinew or green spots.
Chop the onion and fry it in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes until soft.
Add the livers and brown them for 2 minutes a side.
Add the tomatoes and peri-peri to taste and simmer for about 5 minutes, until the livers are cooked through with no pink inside (cut one open to check).
Toast the bread and serve the livers and sauce on top.
